mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.type_relations (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id, extend, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{typeId}, #{targetCategory}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{extend} AS jsonb), #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id) DO UPDATE SET extend = EXCLUDED.extend, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", type_id AS "typeId", target_category AS "targetCategory", target_id AS "targetId", extend::text AS extend, change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.type_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, type_id, target_category, target_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.type_relations_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, type_id, target_category, target_id, extend ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, type_id, target_category, target_id, extend FROM public.type_relations WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, type_id, target_category, target_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, extend = EXCLUDED.extend
